notes: You can see yourself behind walls and buildings now, and the grow dome, warehouse and resources stay solid when you walk behind them.
The reactor shows its fuel waiting by the hatch, warehouse arrows point inward, goods ride on top of the belts, and buildings look smoother.
Alerts shake once then glow steady, VIP orders show a VIP badge, the time star is always last, and impatient traders are flagged on every level.
Opening the game after an update goes straight to the new version.
